meta.site_title: REXAM — Indian Government Exams & Scholarships for You
meta.site_description: Discover government exams, recruitments and scholarships you are eligible for. We check age, qualification and category against official notices.

disclaimer.top_banner: REXAM is an independent student platform, not a government website. Always verify on the official notification before applying.
disclaimer.footer_notice: REXAM is not an official government website. We aggregate publicly published notifications from official portals. Candidates must verify all criteria, dates, and instructions on the official notification before applying.

home.hero_title: Know which government exams you can apply for
home.hero_subtitle: Tell us your qualification, age and state once. We check official notifications from UPSC, SSC, Railways and State PSCs to show only the exams and scholarships you qualify for.
home.how_it_works_subtitle: Four simple steps to find government examinations and scholarships matching your profile.
home.step_1_desc: Add your age, state, qualification and category. It takes less than two minutes.
home.step_2_desc: We check eligibility rules directly from official advertisements released by public bodies.
home.step_3_desc: Every listing clearly shows Eligible, Not eligible, or Need more info with the exact reason.
home.step_4_desc: Click straight to the official government application portal with no middleman or fees.
home.featured_subtitle: Recently published notifications from central ministries and state commissions.
home.trust_heading: Built to be calm, simple and honest
home.trust_no_middleman: Direct official links only. We never charge application fees or hold your forms.
home.trust_transparent: Full breakdown for every eligibility result so you know exactly why you qualify.

dashboard.matching_subtitle: Showing opportunities matching your qualifications and age with applicable statutory relaxations.
dashboard.no_matches_desc: We didn't find active recruitment notifications matching your exact qualification today. Check all listings or update your profile qualifications.
dashboard.not_eligible_notice: These opportunities are currently closed to your profile due to age limits or specific degree requirements in the official notification. We display them for full transparency.
dashboard.missing_profile_title: Missing profile details required for verification
dashboard.missing_profile_desc: Please provide your Date of Birth or complete your educational qualifications so we can calculate your eligibility.
dashboard.profile_complete: Your profile is complete! All available opportunities have been evaluated.
dashboard.no_saved_desc: Bookmark opportunities from the Explorer or Eligible tab to track them here.
dashboard.no_applied_desc: Track recruitment examinations you have applied for, along with admit card and result stages.

wizard.title: Candidate Profile Setup
wizard.step1_sub: Your name and age are checked against minimum and maximum age criteria in official notifications.
wizard.step2_sub: Used to apply statutory age and fee relaxations per official government reservation rules.
wizard.step3_sub: We match your education against minimum qualification requirements in official advertisements.
wizard.step4_sub: Checks whether you meet passing year eligibility (final year appearing vs already completed).
